picks.title: Siri AI keeps getting better, here’s what’s new in iOS 27.2
picks.rationale: New release: Apple shipped the 27.2 updates on every platform, adding new Siri AI features. According to Korean coverage, this is also when the Siri AI beta adds Korean, one of six supported languages.
picks.excerpt: Apple is rolling out its 27.2 software updates today, and they introduce several improvements for Siri AI. Here’s what’s new.

picks.title: Researchers develop a new forensic tool that can recover deleted AI chats from your phone’s memory
picks.rationale: New research: Georgia Tech's ORISA tool recovers deleted conversations from local AI chatbot apps on a phone and rebuilds them into a working session. Deleting a chat does not mean the data is gone from the device.
picks.excerpt: Think deleting an AI chat erases everything? Georgia Tech researchers developed a forensic tool that can recover deleted conversations from local AI apps and rebuild the information into a working session.

picks.title: Ray-Ban Meta: How to stop your glasses from training AI
picks.rationale: New setting: the Meta AI app now has a toggle that stops images captured by Ray-Ban Meta glasses from being used to train Meta's AI, plus a second toggle for voice recordings outside the US. The article explains where US owners have fewer options.
picks.excerpt: Ask your Ray-Ban Meta glasses about what you're looking at, and Meta stores that image and may use it to train its AI. A new setting in the Meta AI app turns this off, and a second one covers voice recordings outside the US. Here is what each setting covers, where US owners have less choice and what

picks.title: Nvidia RTX 20, 30, and 40-series GPUs hacked to remove a half-speed AI throttle — firmware exploit doubles RTX 4090
picks.rationale: New finding: a firmware exploit removes Nvidia's half-rate tensor throttle on GeForce RTX 20/30/40 cards, doubling the RTX 4090's peak tensor rate. Tom's Hardware notes that real workloads gain much less and chatbot token speeds barely change.
picks.excerpt: Real workloads gain less than peak tensor rates, and chatbot token speeds stay about the same.

picks.title: Major Even Realities G2 smart glasses update adds Conversate 'Pro Mode,' Knowledge Base
picks.rationale: New software release: Even Realities is rolling out a major G2 firmware/app update that adds a Conversate 'Pro Mode' and a Knowledge Base the glasses' AI can draw on. These are new features, not a re-review of the hardware.

This is a new software release, not the 27.0 launch (09-27 Tom's Guide card) or the 10-11 personal-data indexing how-to.

https://9to5google.com/2026/10/26/even-r.new_action: Even Realities announced and began rolling out a new G2 software version on 2026-10-26 that adds Conversate 'Pro Mode' and a Knowledge Base. The 10-20 Engadget card was a hardware review, so this is a new release.
